scope_branches.branch: Operation or movement on the separately established restricted street.

source_law_text: No vehicle in excess of eight thousand pounds unladen weight shall be operated or moved upon any street (other than a truck route), in any residence district between the hours of seven p.m. and six a.m.; provided, however, that the Department of Public Works may, at its discretion, upon application in writing, issue a special permit in writing authorizing the applicant to operate or move such vehicle between the hours of seven p.m. and six a.m. In issuing such permit, the Department may impose such conditions thereon, such as routes to be followed, time of operation or movement, or other matters, as it deems necessary or desirable.
summary_conflicts: Do not adopt summary or witness as legal authority; exact law controls. Unreviewed historical summaries remain provisional.
